card.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
card.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the dragon's naming ceremony, where do we put the fire extinguishers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dragon eats anyone who brings one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Who handles the insurance exemption?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the deposit needs to cover the hall.

mechanism: A accepts the dragon naming and its extinguisher taboo, then pursues responsibility for the uninsured venue risk.
confusable: Unlike explaining away the dragon or celebrating it, A should convert each institutional constraint into concrete permissions, deadlines or obligations.
comparison: The ceremony alternative needs a practical deposit plan when insurance fails; the owl alternative already assigns overtime and delivery cover.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
